thread.title: Three Triad firms land on Fortune's 'Most Admired Companies' list

author: Rebecca Troyer
title: Three Triad firms land on Fortune's 'Most Admired Companies' list
text: Jan 22, 2018, 6:49am EST Three Triad firms have landed on Fortune's list of "Most Admired Companies" for 2018. BB&T, Laboratory Corporation Holdings of America (LabCorp) and VF Corp. were among the 11 North Carolina companies that made the list. Fortune surveyed about 3,900 industry analysts, executives and directors to come up with the ratings, which are based on nine factors: innovation, people management, use of corporate assets, social responsibility, quality of management, financial soundness, long-term investment, quality of products/services and global competitiveness. VF Corp (NYSE: VFC) ranked No. 2 in the apparel category, the same as last year. LabCorp (NYSE: LH) ranked no. 5 in the category of "Health care: Pharmacy and other services," moving up from No. 9 last year. BB&T (NYSE: BBT) ranked No. 4 among superregional banks, the same ranking as last year. Other North Carolina companies on the list are Bank of America (NYSE: BAC), Sealed Air Corp. (SEE), Coca Cola Bottling Co. Consolidated (NASDAQ: COKE), Duke Energy Corp. (NYSE: DUK), Lowe's Cos. Inc. (NYSE: LOW) and Nucor Corp. (NYSE: NUE), all based in Charlotte; and Red Hat Inc. (NYSE: RHT) and IQVIA Holdings Inc. (NYSE: ISV) in the Triangle. The top five companies on the list are Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN), Alphabet (NYSE: GOOG), Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE: BRK.A) and Starbucks (NASDAQ: SBUX).
